title: THE KEY LISTS USE THE WINDOW
why: His note after playing: the UI is not as clean as it should be. In the pictures, CHANGE KEYS and CHANGE PAD BUTTONS were one column 1100 pixels wide in a 1920 pixel window, the right 40 percent empty, with thirty rows to scroll through. They list the actions in two columns across the window now, each section heading across both, so the same rows take half the height. The rows, the keycaps and REBIND are unchanged.
now: CHANGE KEYS and CHANGE PAD BUTTONS list the actions in two columns.
